title: M01 acceptance audit: no revenue-ready acceptance criteria are passed
primary_blockers: M02: approved product quantity, pricing, free/premium economy
M03: real authenticated server and durable atomic SQL ledger
M04: provider merchant setup, signed payment/receipt verification and refund recovery
M05: real shop UX, restoration/privacy/customer service
M08: analytics, settlement, legal and live purchase evidence

checks.criterion: all SKU IDs immutable, currency KRW per region price from provider, contents explicit
checks.evidence: Five immutable draft SKU identifiers and KRW catalog currency, but no verified provider pricing/contents.
checks.blocking_requirement: Live independent verification and platform approval required

requirements_to_lift_live_gate: Pricing and catalog from trusted provider and merchant onboarding
Server auth and tamper-resistant entitlement journal
Trusted provider signature or provider API verification not user-supplied flags
Atomic credit, spend, refund and idempotency across concurrent workers
Restore/delete/export policy, fraud controls, error UX and refunds
Actual operator-authorized payment in suitable live environment, user testing
